title: A brilliant guide for a wonderful city
text: My mum is in her nineties so we needed a tour that was flexible for her needs and energy levels. Bea met us at the hotel then guided us round the city, taking in all the best attractions. Friendly, warm and incredibly knowledgeable, she made our day so special.
author: Lisette T

title: Best private tour in Seville
text: Beatriz was amazing. She was deeply proud of her wonderful city, highly knowledgable of the cathedral and Alcazar and so many of the Seville  ins and outs. We had a crazy day with the city overtaken by a big football game. My sister and I thoroughly enjoyed her, and she was respectful of some mobility issues. She escorted us and made sure we got back to our cruise ship when no taxis or busses were available, and traffic was terrible. She is very caring, besides the obvious tour guide background.
author: Elenmary_B

title: We recommend her 100% – an exceptional guide and a truly lovely soul.
text:
We had the absolute pleasure of exploring Seville with Beatriz, and we couldn’t have asked for a more wonderful guide. She was warm, friendly, and incredibly easy-going – the kind of person you feel instantly comfortable with. Her knowledge of Seville’s history, stories, and culture was exceptional, but it was the way she shared it all – so naturally, so passionately, and with such genuine joy – that made the experience unforgettable.

author: R9230JCmichelleb

title: Perfect experience!
text: Excellent private tour with flexibility and a wealth of knowledge! Carmen is full of local knowledge and knows all the history. She can answer any questions and makes you feel comfortable.
author: Leslie_H

title: Flexible and custom private tour for a family with a young child
text: As a family with a young child, we wanted a custom experience with flexibility and the right pacing; Beatriz delivered! She highlighted animal encounters in the ancient sites, satisfying our kid; but also dove deep into history and “hidden details” enough to intrigue a history student. She was happy to work around our child-centered schedule. We would call her again when we are next in Seville!
author: sinannyc

title: Fantastic and Insightful Private Tour of Seville - Best Guide
text: Beatriz did a marvelous job in providing us with an insightful and educational private tour of the Seville’s beautiful Alcázar, Cathedral and Jewish quarters (Juderia). She is  personable, engaging and of course very knowledgeable in the history of Seville. She is also fluent in English. We highly recommend her as a tour guide.
author: J8056DQrayc

title: A Great Private Tour of Seville
text: Beatriz was a wonderful guide for us to explore the Royal Palace and incredible Cathedral.  She was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about her role.  Beatriz also has a very good sense of humor and was fun to be with during our tour.  Seeing and hearing is so much more meaningful than simply walking through these phenomenal historic sites.  I would highly recommend this tour.
author: Dan_T

title: Visit Top with Beatriz!
text: We made a visit with Beatriz and we were delighted. She was very close to us and knew what she was talking about, the time flew by. We would repeat with her!
author: E6059QWjavierp

title: Wonderful day
text:
This was the most fabulous way to discover Seville. Beatriz lead our group of 18 teenagers around in an interesting and welcoming manner. 

The tempo was steady, with time to stop for pictures and drinks in the heat. 
I would love to return to Seville and have Beatriz accompany me on another tour of other parts of the city. 

A true Sevillana.
author: jonpaulp893

title: Professional guide who loves her city
text:
Beatriz is such a knowledgeable and friendly guide! I have learned a lot with her. If you want to experience Seville with a local professional guide, Beatriz is the one to call :) She's very dedicated and passionate about her job, and it shows!

Beatriz es una guía muy preparada y simpática! He aprendido mucho con ella. Si quieres vivir Sevilla con una guía local profesional, Beatriz es la indicada :) Es una persona dedicada y apasionada de su trabajo, y eso se nota en sus tours!
author: seasidesky
